evidence: glm-5: "Strictly negative minimum iff cu != cv" and "We need a 3-coloring of the graph"; gpt-oss-120b: "domain masks ... colour 1, 2, 3" and "depth-first search in lexicographic order"; deepseek-v4-flash: adjacency lists with colors tried from 1 to 3 and rejection when "colors[nb] == c"
affordance_in_statement: The interaction energy ... is modeled by the quadratic function: $E(x) = x^2 - (c_u + c_v)x + c_u c_v$ ... The global minimum value of this interaction energy function $E(x)$ (over all real numbers $x$) must be strictly negative.
removal_suggestion: There is no wording-only way to remove this reduction while preserving the same mathematical task: the displayed polynomial factors as $(x-c_u)(x-c_v)$, so its minimum condition intrinsically becomes $c_u \ne c_v$. The interaction-energy rule must instead be changed or presented through a genuinely non-equivalent, non-separable condition whose validity is not determined solely by whether the endpoint concentrations differ.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats every constraint as a three-color inequality constraint and searches colors in lexicographic order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Each edge's quadratic has a strictly negative minimum exactly when its endpoint concentrations differ.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Factors the quadratic and directly reduces the problem to graph 3-coloring.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The interaction energy is $x^2-(c_u+c_v)x+c_uc_v$, whose minimum is strictly negative iff $c_u \ne c_v$.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses ordinary backtracking 3-coloring on the constraint graph, trying colors 1, 2, and 3 in order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The strict-negative-minimum condition is equivalent to requiring different concentration levels at every constrained pair.

common_affordance: The displayed quadratic energy factors into $(x-c_u)(x-c_v)$, making every constraint exactly the graph-coloring condition $c_u \ne c_v$.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Although it recognized the same inequality/3-coloring reduction, it attempted exhaustive enumeration over all $3^n$ assignments rather than using constraint-pruned search, causing TLE for $n \le 40$.

recommended_edit: Replace the displayed separable quadratic energy law with a genuinely non-separable interaction rule whose minimum condition depends on more than endpoint inequality, while retaining the required input/output formats and examples where possible. A wording-only edit will not defeat the survivors because the 3-coloring reduction is intrinsic to the current formula.
